name: Fushun Special Steel Co.,LTD.
summary: Fushun Special Steel Co.,LTD., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel products in China and internationally. The company provides alloy structural steel, tool and die steel, stainless steel, and high-temperature alloys; and bearing steel, titanium alloy, high strength steel, and superalloy products. It also provides dining and accommodation; and property services. Its products are used in aviation, aerospace, weapons, nuclear power, petroleum and petrochemical, transportation, engineering machinery, medical, and other industries. Fushun Special Steel Co.,LTD. was founded in 1937 and is based in Fushun City, China.
